scope: Fourth noncanonical/unapplied proposal. Durable reservation binding, one-use service handoff and metadata completion/recovery guards. Registration application continuation remains unwired.

capabilities.browser: Existing reservation, Storage predicate and recovery RPC grants only; no operation/token in their unchanged receipt schemas. New control/scope/outcome helpers are owner-internal.
capabilities.service: Only new claim_document_upload_registration_operation(uuid,uuid,text); immutable one-shot claim after current actor/source/access/object metadata checks.
capabilities.tables: New private binding table has RLS and zero raw privileges for PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role. Trigger helpers have no client/service execute grants.
capabilities.product_writes: Existing caller-RLS document insert and all original private checks are retained. New helpers do not grant private student access or write document content.

behavior: Reservation insertion atomically creates one server-generated register operation and immutable actor/student/path/claimed-hash/review binding. Exact reserved retries do not create another lease.
Pause denies new intervals; already-admitted, exact active intervals may drain while counted. No untracked legacy attempt is adopted.
Service handoff pins the managed object ID/version once. Lost claim reply cannot be recovered or replayed; Storage re-upload and repeated reservation are blocked after claim.

Direct unclaimed registration or changed object cannot pass. A registered row leaves the operation active; only matching clean/provider/hash/queue metadata or confirmed infection/quarantine can settle it.
Original-actor review holds atomically retain needs_review operations and existing capacity. No reopening, expiry, deletion, reset or automatic release.
Recovery keeps original actor/access/source checks, refuses active/uncertain work and returns only the old non-token result after confirmed completion.
Guarded completion reads only necessary metadata. Other operation kinds/unbound foundation tests keep their existing protocol.
limitations: No registration-handler continuation adapter, required-viewer schema change or browser interrupted-work wiring in this change. Coherent application integration is required before rollout.
Original actor5/student10 unresolved reservation caps remain; broader active-registered/held-operation limits and authorized manual reconciliation remain open.
Claimed hash and managed object metadata are not byte attestation, provider cancellation or proof of quiescence. Actual handler must check its same copy and every domain receipt before finishing.
Existing attempts (including registered) cause installation refusal instead of backfill. Historical/provider/direct-writer review and final canonical/ledger packaging remain open.
The earlier transaction-only fence stage is superseded for exact admitted drains; its pre-fourth artifact is stage-specific, not final-schema proof.
Website and separately deployed worker are unchanged; fresh hosted authorization and acceptance remain required.
